town_description: Sabroom is Tripura's southernmost sub-divisional town in South Tripura district, on the Bangladesh border about 134 km from Agartala. It is known for the Mahamuni Buddhist pagoda, the Kalapania Eco Park, and as the southern terminus of the Agartala–Sabroom rail line.
